prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Experience", "Select whether to build a custom pet companion from photos or adopt a ready-to-play pet friend."]
1: ["Preview Companion Styles", "Browse animated visual styles to find the look that best fits your desktop environment."]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Environment", "Configure your pet desktop settings while your companion is being generated.", "Enable desktop roaming", "Enable sound effects"]
3: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Use keyboard shortcuts or the tray icon to command, converse with, or hide your desktop pet anytime.", "Start Playing"]
4: ["Signing in anchors your pet to your account so your custom companion is safely backed up."]
5: ["For best generation accuracy, upload clear photos with full lighting and your pet centered."]
6: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World"]
7: ["Instant Cloud Backup Included"]
8: ["Tip: Click the pet icon in your system tray anytime to summon or manage your pet on desktop."]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Implies commercial offer or free extra ('Included')
